scope: TEST-only public-read observation; no product source or timing budgets changed
notes: First five tests failed for absent behavior before implementation. Earlier setup failures are not counted as behavioral RED.
Each phase has permanent numbered read/API files; active snapshots are convenience copies.
A bounded last-failure ring records droppedFailures and truncated. Transactions retain their starting phase.
Per-stage duplicate schema validation and synchronous file output add diagnostic overhead. Enable only for diagnosis, not a strictly comparable performance result.
Gateway/API timing and operation IDs help correlate but are not a shared cross-layer request ID.
Default observer absent leaves original transport responses and application persistence composition unchanged.
No browser, build or broad test was run by this subtask.
Failures include generated observedAt UTC timestamps.
Gateway captureGatewayObserver binds each request to its initial phase; late responses update only that archived phase.
API records explicitly label phaseAssociation COMPLETION_ONLY and do not claim request-start attribution.
transportCode is a fixed allowlist read through own data descriptors on error/cause at most three objects deep; getters never invoked.
